caption: The drawing depicts two stoneware vessels placed side by side against a plain, light beige background. The vessel on the left has a rounded body, a narrow neck with a pronounced lip, and a single curved handle attached from the shoulder to just below the mouth, while the vessel on the right is similarly shaped but lacks a handle. Both objects are rendered in grey tones with a slightly speckled appearance, and each vessel features a decorative scalloped pattern near the shoulder area made up of blue circular accents. The vessels occupy the central area of the composition and are positioned parallel to each other, each casting a subtle shadow below. The surface of the vessels suggests a matte, ceramic texture.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
